name: San Martín de Valdeiglesias (Spain)
description: Divided into three parts by two diagonal lines, green at the upper fly, white in the centre and blue at the lower hoist, charged with the crowned municipal arms of San Martín de Valdeiglesias (a crescent on dark blue within a bordure of crosses).
history: The design of the flag was approved on 25 June 2009 and published on 16 September 2009: a flag of proportions 2:3, tierced per bend with the central band double, blue, white and green, charged at its centre with the arms. The silver crescent of the arms alludes to the arms of Álvaro de Luna.
